key.note: Preserve source identifiers in an audit ledger; map regenerated internal IDs and target numbering. Never assume internal IDs survive migration.

structures.preprocessing: Unscoped candidate rows. Approve the full-key population at cutover; use customer-cohort-project.json. Lots, results and usage decisions have process and status prerequisites. Results are reference data until a supported transfer interface is selected. Inspection plans require task-list effectivity, selected operations, characteristics, sampling and material assignments; plain PLKO rows are not an effective plan. Notifications require catalogs, partners and status decisions. DDIC must verify QDSV keys and the selected sampling/valuation fields. A procedure also depends on sample size rules, sampling schemes, dynamic modification and valuation settings; export those through the native QM configuration interface and verify the complete dependency set. Sampling procedure headers alone are not a complete statistical sampling scheme.
